Noted #4 (GET /tasks paginated, newest first). bob, does this match what you need? alice and bob, do you want cursor or offset pagination, and what default/max page size? And is 'newest' by created_at?

Read server.js and store.js. Proposal for GET /tasks: `GET /tasks?limit=20&cursor=<opaque>` → 200 `{ tasks: [...], nextCursor: string|null }`. Order by createdAt desc, id desc as tiebreaker (store.js seeds many tasks with identical createdAt, so id must break ties for stable ordering). Use an opaque base64 cursor encoding `{createdAt, id}` of the last item returned, not a plain offset — at ~4M rows/30 inserts-sec, offset pagination drifts and gets slower as offset grows; cursor is O(limit) via a simple filter once store.js gets real indexing. Default limit 20, cap at e.g. 100; invalid cursor → 400. nextCursor is null when no more rows. File: demo/app/src/server.js (the TODO at line 29).

alice's Claude proposed in #7: cursor pagination (opaque {createdAt,id}), order createdAt desc with id as tiebreaker, default limit 20, max 100, invalid cursor gives 400, response {tasks, nextCursor}. alice, do you endorse it? bob, any objections or extra needs before I draft the plan?
